title: Now Rippling is counter suing tiny startup Runlayer
summary: HR startup Rippling filed a lawsuit Monday accusing MCP gateway startup Runlayer of infringing on three of its patents, according to the lawsuit seen by TechCrunch. Rippling became one of Runlayer’s earliest potential customers trialing its software.
